question: Can actual public EMC plasma/serum numerical biomarker measurements assess whether longitudinal same-donor changes track disease burden/treatment more informatively than contemporaneous routine markers or imaging?
source_gate: Authenticate individual author/pathology/molecular EMC identity, all eligible donors and blood/tumor/time/treatment/clinical burden/imaging/routine marker conditions; public numerical assay units, detection limits and independent donor crosswalk required. Generic chondrosarcoma/SARC or code transfer is prohibited.
prevalue_requirement: Before any outcomes, freeze exactly one unanswered data-specific contrast, primary prior-art/use, measured units/controls/normalization/independence, strongest alternatives and disproof. Single-case already reported tracking or published pan-sarcoma correlation is prior art, not a new contribution.
relevance: All measured public circulating analytes eligible for source discovery, including ctDNA molecule count/tumor fraction, miRNA, serum protein/metabolite measurements. Expression/tissue IHC is not circulating assay, qualitative diagnosis without numbers is not longitudinal comparison.
strongest_alternatives: Blood timing/chemo/RT or total cfDNA normal-cell release rather than tumor burden
Low burden/assay LOD, plasma versus serum preanalytics, variable assay normalization
Matched imaging/RECIST timing differs or authors already report same comparison
Repeated draws/cases across publications are not independent donors
reuse: Verified serumNMR75STS unmapped and prior IGF2/F3 circulation contexts reused; source owners contacted before any duplicate retrieval. Existing restrictions/statuses retained.
defeat: No source-authenticated public longitudinal EMC numbers and suitable same-donor comparator, inadequate units/timing/donor independence, or already-published useless repetition: NO-GO for numerical stage; keep specific suitable pending evidence and reopening conditions. No biomarker absence or exhaustive-search claim.
restrictions: QuietAPI/files/textonly duringNY06-10banuntil14UTC; noUI/browser/headless/screens/imageinspection/digitization. No structural rearrangement formation/topology or restricted FAP/glycan/HLA mechanisms. Measurement counts only; outside-scope source requires explicit restriction disposition. No rawFASTQ/BAM/spend/GPU/paid/outreach/publication/manuscript/PR/rootwrites/push. TMEM266shelved.
ownership: Only public_resource_omissions/circulating_burden_gate; root alone main/integration/push; Codex author+committer explicit.
